recreation_prompts.t2i_start_frame: A middle-aged Korean man, stocky build with a round face, short neatly trimmed black hair that is slightly salt-and-pepper at the temples, clean-shaven with visible natural skin texture including slight pores and lived-in character, dressed in a crisp bright white cotton dress shirt fully buttoned at the collar and cuffs, and a textured woven dark cornflower blue necktie with a tight half-Windsor knot, stands inside a modern Scandinavian-inspired Korean apartment living room during early morning. He is bent forward and downward at the waist, his torso inclined toward something below the frame, his head bowed so his chin nearly touches his chest, and his mouth is slightly open as if mid-sigh, mid-speech, or processing a thought. His gaze is directed downward and off the left side of the frame, giving him an introspective, slightly worried, or preoccupied expression. The scene is bathed in the distinctive soft overexposed quality of early morning daylight streaming in from a large window with full-height vertical sheer white blinds and semi-opaque cream-colored curtains positioned on the left side of the frame behind and around the subject. This window light acts as the primary illumination source and creates a bright, slightly blown-out luminosity behind the subject, rimming his dark hair with a subtle warm halo and washing the background into a gentle cream and white diffusion. The camera angle is slightly elevated, shooting down at the subject from approximately eye-level to a slight high angle, creating a sense of looking at the subject from close range. Behind him and to the right, rendered softly out of focus in warm cream bokeh, are two additional figures: a young woman with a long reddish-auburn ponytail standing near what appears to be a mirror or wardrobe doorway, and a smaller child figure partially visible beside her. The interior background suggests a spacious modern Korean apartment with warm beige and off-white painted walls, characteristic of contemporary Korean residential design. The framing is a medium close-up with the subject positioned slightly left of center in the 16:9 frame, giving him room to breathe on the right side, which is filled with the soft window-lit background bokeh. The lens focal length equivalent is approximately 85mm to 100mm, a classic portrait telephoto that produces the characteristic shallow depth of field keeping the man pin-sharp while rendering the background in smooth, creamy out-of-focus bokeh. The color palette throughout the frame is consistently desaturated and naturalistic, leaning warm: ivory and off-white from the shirt and background walls, the warm light-tan color of his skin, the very dark brown-black of his hair, and the muted cornflower blue of his necktie as the only saturated chromatic accent in the frame. The lighting setup is low-contrast and soft, resembling overcast daylight enhanced with off-camera fill light, producing a 2:1 key-to-fill ratio that creates subtle facial modeling without harsh shadows. The mood is quietly domestic and slightly stressed, the opening beat of a comedy that situates the viewer in a relatable Korean family morning. No brand logos, no identifiable face features beyond the generic Korean adult male appearance. Korean domestic apartment aesthetic, contemporary commercial live-action cinematography.

recreation_prompts.t2i_start_frame: A wide-angle establishing shot capturing the full interior of a bright, spacious, modern Korean apartment living room during morning preparation, rendered in the clean Scandinavian-minimal aesthetic popular among contemporary Korean upper-middle-class households. The scene is lit primarily by a large floor-to-ceiling window with diffused white sheer curtains and vertical blinds on the left wall, flooding the room with soft overexposed morning daylight. The primary subject — a middle-aged Korean man in his late forties, stocky build with short black hair, wearing a pressed bright white cotton dress shirt fully buttoned with a textured woven dark blue necktie, but conspicuously wearing bright blue polka-dotted boxer shorts instead of trousers, along with dark socks — stands at the center-right area of the frame at a portable wooden-framed ironing board. He holds a matte black steam iron in one hand and is in the process of pressing a dark navy-black wool suit jacket laid flat on the ironing board cover. His posture is slightly hunched over the garment, head tilted downward examining the fabric he is ironing, his mouth slightly open mid-speech or reaction. The comedy derives entirely from the visible contrast between the formal top (dress shirt, tie) and the casual bottom (patterned boxer shorts). Behind him to the left, near the large standing mirror and mushroom-shaped white floor lamp, the young woman with an auburn ponytail is adjusting her clothing or hair. A small child peeks around the mirror frame. The room extends fully into the background revealing its complete Scandinavian-Nordic domestic character: a wide cream linen upholstered sofa with scattered decorative cushions in mustard yellow and sage green on the left side of the composition, a small round white Scandinavian-style coffee table in the foreground center carrying a few stacked books and a ceramic coffee mug, a low white media credenza console against the right wall bearing a compact retro-style record player in warm wood and metal finish, a small cream cube speaker, and a framed abstract art print on the white wall above in the style of warm oranges and golds — abstract organic shapes referencing Matisse — in a simple light wood frame. The floor throughout is warm light oak parquet running horizontally, with a cream geometric patterned area rug defining the living zone. The walls are off-white with a very slight warm tint. The lens is a wide approximately 35mm equivalent capturing the full room with slight natural perspective distortion. The color palette is airy and Nordic throughout: ivory whites, warm creams, the vivid mid-blue of the boxer shorts as a comedic accent, the dark charcoal of the suit jacket as a formal contrast, and the scattered mustard, sage, and warm amber accents from the furnishings. Lighting is low-contrast, bright, overcast morning quality, approximately 1.5:1 key-to-fill from the window. The mood is energetic domestic chaos rendered with visual calm. No brand logos visible. Korean commercial live-action aesthetic. The composition is cinematographic, not snapshot. The ironing board is a standard collapsible design with a slim metal tubular frame in silver-grey, the board surface padded and covered in a white heat-resistant fabric with faint grid lines. The man's legs below the boxer shorts are bare with dark compression or dress socks visible at the ankle, grounding the comedy in one final costume detail. The young child partially visible behind the woman adds a third character dimension that establishes this as a family unit, not a couple — making the domestic morning chaos even more universally relatable. The early morning quality of the light and the level of preparation visible on all characters suggests this family is preparing for a trip or important day out, adding narrative urgency to the man's phone-related distraction.

The phone itself is a current-generation rectangular smartphone with very thin bezels and a small pill-shaped front camera cutout at the top of the screen, housed in a slim black protective case with slightly rounded edges. The application interface displayed on the screen is a Korean train booking service login screen. The upper portion of the screen features a dark navy blue header bar with white Korean text positioned toward the top right reading '열차 예매' and below it a small icon-style illustration of a KTX bullet train in grey and silver tones. Below this header, against a white background, the form area shows two labeled input fields: the first labeled '회원번호' (membership number) with a partially entered number visible, and the second labeled '비밀번호' (password) with bullet-dot characters indicating obscured content. A large navy-blue rounded pill-shaped button labeled '로그인' (login) in white text appears prominently below the input fields. Beneath the login button, smaller grey text provides links for password recovery and membership registration. The lower portion of the screen is dominated by a standard Korean numeric keypad layout with the digits 0-9 arranged in grid format, white rounded buttons on a light grey background. The surrounding context visible around the phone includes the wrist and cuff of a crisp white cotton dress shirt with a woven dark blue tie tail visible from the right edge, establishing the character context. Slightly below and behind the phone in shallow depth of field bokeh, the dark surface of a black suit jacket on a pale ironing board cover creates a soft textural background. The composition fills the 16:9 frame with the phone at approximately a 15-degree diagonal tilt, the screen occupying the upper-center of the frame and the numeric keypad dominating the lower half. The lens is approximately 50mm equivalent creating a flat graphic quality without significant perspective distortion. The color palette is dominated by the cool off-white and navy blue of the app UI, the white shirt fabric as a warm contrast element, with the dark blue tie as a saturated middle accent. Lighting is soft and even from above, with the screen itself contributing cool blue-white illumination that slightly color-grades the surrounding skin and fabric. The depth of field is very shallow, keeping only the phone screen and hands in focus. The mood is task-focused urgency layered with underlying frustration. No brand logos beyond the generic train booking app UI. Korean fintech and transport service UI aesthetic rendered with photographic realism. The man's thumb position and the specific numeric input on screen establishes this as the second attempt or continued effort at entering login credentials — the narrative suggests he has already tried once with the QWERTY keyboard and is now trying the numeric PIN approach. The iron visible in the background as a blurred prop recalls the domestic ironing scene, maintaining spatial consistency. The composition deliberately crops out any visual that would reveal the man's lower half, maintaining the surprise for the upcoming wide shots. The specific app UI design reflects the aesthetic of established Korean rail ticketing services, using the corporate navy blue and clean white palette typical of official Korean transportation digital products. The depth of field separation is precise enough to keep individual UI text elements legible for the viewer.

recreation_prompts.t2i_start_frame: A medium shot of a middle-aged Korean man with a stocky build and short black hair, dressed in a crisp white cotton dress shirt fully buttoned with a textured woven dark blue necktie, standing in the center of the composition in his bright modern Korean apartment living room. He faces the camera directly, establishing a quasi-fourth-wall-breaking moment typical of contemporary Korean advertising comedy. Both hands hold a black smartphone at waist level, loosely gripped and slightly angled toward him, but his attention is not on the phone — his eyes look directly into the camera lens with a flat, exasperated, comedic deadpan expression combining resignation, disbelief, and dark humor. The expression has the quality of a person who has given up explaining their frustration and is instead presenting it to an unseen sympathetic witness. The eyebrows are barely elevated, the mouth is a flat neutral line, the eyes carry the weight of accumulated defeat. He may be wearing his blue boxer shorts below frame given the established visual comedy of the scene, but this shot is framed tightly enough at medium shot that only the shirt and tie are clearly visible. Behind him, the living room extends in clear detail with excellent depth and naturalistic focus separation: to the frame left, the woman with auburn ponytail is visible mid-ground near the full-length mirror doing something with her clothing — creating background action that reinforces the 'everyone is busy except him' comedy tension. The full Scandinavian-minimal living room set is established clearly: cream sofa with yellow and green cushions left side, wooden floor lamp with mushroom shade, standing mirror, white media credenza with retro record player on the right, warm abstract art print on the white wall right, large window with diffused morning light providing the key illumination from the left. The floor is light oak parquet with a cream geometric rug. The composition uses a classic medium shot with the man centered in the frame, approximately waist-to-head, the apartment visible as a clean symmetrical backdrop behind him. The lens is approximately 35mm to 40mm equivalent, capturing the man and the full living room context with moderate depth rendering. The color palette is warm and airy: ivory whites, cream, sage green and mustard accent colors in the furnishings, dark blue tie, and the record player's warm wood finish as additional warm accent. Lighting is soft, even, morning quality, low-contrast, with the window providing a gentle left-side key and even fill throughout the interior. No harsh shadows. The mood is comedic deadpan, Korean commercial style, naturalistic realism. The woman visible in the background performing a continuous action creates a natural mise-en-scène principle where the background remains alive while the foreground subject establishes the comedic fourth-wall beat. The record player visible on the credenza right of the background is likely spinning, adding the implication of morning music in the household — a detail that reinforces the character of this family as design-conscious, cultured, and modern. The Matisse-style art print on the wall is a strong visual character indicator: this is a Korean professional couple with aesthetic sensibility who shop at design-conscious home furnishing retailers. The man's failure to figure out the login is therefore doubly comic — he is clearly intelligent and has good taste, but this digital friction defeats him completely. The deadpan direct camera gaze is a beloved technique in contemporary Korean advertising that creates an instant comedic complicity between subject and viewer.

The lower fifty percent of the screen is occupied by the expanded QWERTY keyboard layout: rows of grey rectangular rounded keys displaying the full Latin alphabet in lowercase, with number row at the top, special character keys on the sides, space bar at the bottom, and a Korean/English language toggle key visible as well as an emoji or keyboard-switch key. A thumb is visible mid-press on one of the alphabetic keys with slight motion blur indicating active typing. The right hand grips the phone while the left thumb or right thumb operates the keyboard. The surrounding context shows the wrist and lower shirt cuff of the white dress shirt. The background behind and below the phone is dark and blurred, suggesting the ironing board or dark suit jacket surface. The color palette is cool and functional: light grey and white of the keyboard keys, the navy blue UI elements above, white form fields, dark text, all against the warm contrast of the shirt fabric. The screen emits cool blue-white light. The mood is acute frustration — typing a forgotten password in an archaic login flow. No legible brand marks. Korean fintech and transport UI design language rendered photographically. The visual appearance of the QWERTY keyboard in a Korean context is itself a source of humor — the Latin alphabet keyboard being used to type what turns out to be an alphanumeric password for a Korean service, requiring the user to switch keyboard modes, adding an extra layer of complexity to an already frustrating login process. The partial visibility of the password field showing numeric characters establishes that the membership number was successfully entered but the password is the sticking point — the specific pain of password fatigue and credential recall failure is precisely targeted. The hand positioning with both palms gripping the phone frame and a thumb operating the keyboard is the universal modern smartphone usage posture, instantly recognizable across age demographics. The background darkness behind the phone creates strong visual figure-ground separation that makes the screen content the sole focus.

Her expression is composed and gentle rather than distressed. The camera is positioned at approximately eye level or very slightly below, shooting from a distance equivalent to 85mm focal length, which renders the background in soft smooth bokeh. In the foreground extreme near-camera, the completely out-of-focus edge and surface of the ironing board creates a blurred foreground plane that establishes depth and the spatial relationship between the two characters. The background consists of the full-height sheer white curtains of the large window, through which bright diffused morning sunlight creates a luminous backlit quality that rims the woman's hair and shoulder with a gentle warm highlight, creating an almost glowing halo effect on her hair in the backlight.
